summary: Comprehensive spec audit and LLM-agnostic architectural roadmap for Gotz.Puppyt Hand Rig v2. Eliminates all proprietary/tool-specific references (including OpenClaw), structures the two-way Google Docs synchronization protocol, and provides modular, self-contained specifications for Phases 3.C through 4 while locking verified Phase 3.A and 3.B baselines.
